_comment: Observation/state model for the agent. The state is the attacker's accumulating knowledge, rebuilt step-by-step by assemble.py from action outcomes. This file documents the shape; it is not loaded at runtime.

global.phase_reached: enum — furthest kill-chain phase reached this episode (Reconnaissance < Delivery < Exploitation < Installation < CommandAndControl < ActionsOnObjectives)
global.attacker_on_link: bool — attacker positioned on the L2 segment (enables ARP/DNS MITM)

fields.creds: list[{service, user, secret_ref}] — recovered creds (secret stored only in run folder, referenced here)
fields.phase_reached: enum — furthest phase reached against THIS target

outcome_effects._comment: How a successful action updates state (assemble.py applies these to build state_before/state_after).
